narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think the letter eigh must be one fixed number, so the rule works for one age only.
<bookmark mark='s1'/>Aftab is four, then ten, then twenty three, and the rule stays the same.
<bookmark mark='s2'/>A rule that fits every age cannot be tied to one number.
